brandScale.description: Fixed sRGB tints and shades of each exact identity color. Negative amounts mix with white; positive amounts mix with black. Shades retain the seed's hue and saturation. These are brand-relative steps, not equal perceived lightness across different hues.

identity.description: Logo ink is independent of interface accent colors. Dark mode retains every exact master color. Light variants select a fixed shade from the same brand scale.

sharedNeutral.description: One achromatic primitive ramp shared by all identities and both modes. Inspired by the user's earlier neutral palette, with revised middle grays and explicit role mapping. Stops remain fixed; semantic roles change with mode.

font.heading: 'Sora Variable', Sora, system-ui, sans-serif
font.evidence: User selected Sora headings and Graphie only if on Google Fonts; otherwise Inter. Graphie is distributed by Dharma Type/Adobe Fonts, so Inter is used. Heading weight 700 and body 400/700 follow the user's typography reference. Font files are served locally from pinned Fontsource packages.
